detail.description:
A beautiful scenic run. Starts remote and ends in Wanakena at the lake. There are some larger drops, but generally it is a rocky manageable ride.  Be alert for trees in the river.

**Governour - Cranberry Lake Area Reaches:**

[Black Creek](https://www.americanwhitewater.org/content/River/detail/id/1257/) [Boland Creek](https://www.americanwhitewater.org/content/River/detail/id/1260/)

[Indian (Oswegatchi Tributary)](https://www.americanwhitewater.org/content/River/detail/id/1326/) [Island Branch](https://www.americanwhitewater.org/content/River/detail/id/1328/)

[Jenny Creek](https://www.americanwhitewater.org/content/River/detail/id/4249/) [Little](https://www.americanwhitewater.org/content/River/detail/id/1337/)

[Oswegatchi (Owbow to Elmdale)](https://www.americanwhitewater.org/content/River/detail/id/1366/) [Oswegatchi East Branch Sect. 1](https://www.americanwhitewater.org/content/River/detail/id/1368/)

[Oswegatchi East Branch Sect. 2](https://www.americanwhitewater.org/content/River/detail/id/1369/) [Oswegatchi East Branch Sect. 3](https://www.americanwhitewater.org/content/River/detail/id/5501/)

[Oswegatchi East Branch Sect. 4](https://www.americanwhitewater.org/content/River/detail/id/1367/)[Oswegatchi Middle Branch Sect. 1](https://www.americanwhitewater.org/content/River/detail/id/1370/)

[Oswegatchi Middle Branch Sect. 2](https://www.americanwhitewater.org/content/River/detail/id/1371/) [Oswegatchi Middle Branch Sect. 4 (Sluice Falls)](https://www.americanwhitewater.org/content/River/detail/id/5456/)

[Oswegatchi West Branch (Bisha to Jerden)](https://www.americanwhitewater.org/content/River/detail/id/1373/) [Oswegatchi West Branch (Fullerville to Oswegatchi)](https://www.americanwhitewater.org/content/River/detail/id/1372/)

[Sawyer Creek](https://www.americanwhitewater.org/content/River/detail/id/1417/)
